caption:
And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."

Surah Al-Furqan (25:74). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #IslamicReminder #Ayah #Deen #IslamicGuidance

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-17) of GET /v1/ayah/25:74/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "And those who say, \"Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.\""
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Raw: "他们说：我们的主啊！求你以我们的妻子儿女为我们的安慰，求你以我们为敬畏者的典范。". Used verbatim.
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "기뻐할 수 있는 아내와 자손들을 주옵소서 그리고 저희들이 정직한 사람들의 모범이 되도록 하여 주옵소서 라고 말하는 자들 이라". Spacing-only fix: '자들 이라' -> '자들이라'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "そして，「主よ，心の慰めとなる妻と子孫をわたしたちに与え，主を畏れる者の模範にして下さい。」と（祈って）言う者。"
